title: Jehoahaz and Jehoash in Samaria
reflectionText: Jehoahaz sought Yahweh, and Israel received deliverance from Syrian oppression. Yet the account also records the sins that remained. What do you notice about the help given, the condition of the people, and the continuing conduct described in the reigns of Jehoahaz and his son?
